ओ: ओ The vowel O, and the thirteenth of the Nāgarī alphabet.
ओ ind. 1 A vocative particle, (oh.) 2 An interjection of calling, (ho, hola.) 3 Of reminiscence, (ho, ah.) 4 Of compassionating, (ah, oh.)
ओक: ओक m. (-कः) 1 A house. 2 An asylum, a refuge: see ओकम्. 3 A bird. E. उच to assemble, क aff.
ओकण: ओकण m. (-णः) A bug; also ओकणि.
ओकस्: ओकस् n. (-कः) 1 An asylum, a place of refuge. 2 A house. E. उच to collect, असुन Uṇādi affix, च becomes क.
ओकुल: ओकुल m. (-लः) A cake of flour.
ओख: ओख r. 1st. cl (ऋ) ओखृ (ओखति and with a prefix, as प्र, प्रोखति.) 1 To be dry or arid. 2 To adorn. 3 To be able or competent, to suffice. 4 To refuse or prevent.
ओघ: ओघ m. (-घः) 1 A heap or quantity, flock or multitude. 2 A stream, a torrent, a rapid flow of water, an inundation. 3 Quick time in music. 4 Tradition. 5 Advice, instruction. E. उच to collect, घञ् affix, and च is changed to घ.
ओङ्कार: ओङ्कार m. (-रः) The mysterious name of the deity: see ओम्. f. (-रा) A Bauddha Śakti, or female personification of divine energy. E. ओम, and कार affix implying a letter, the compound letter ओ; otherwise ओम्, signifying assent, and कार who makes; what complies with our wishes.
ओज: ओज (त) r. 1st cl. (ओजति) 1 To live, to have the vital faculties and organs. 2 To be strong or able.
ओजस्: ओजस् n. (-जः) 1 Light, splendor. 2 Manifestation, appearance. 3 Strength. 4 Support, stay. 5 Metallic lustre. 6 Vitality, the principle of vital warmth and action diffused throughout the body. 7 Virility, the generative faculty. 8 A form of style, elaborate style, abounding with compounds. 9 (In astrology,) Each alternate sign of the zodiac, first, third, fifth, &c. E. ओज to live, and असुन् affix; or with अच् affix ओज.
ओजस्विन्: ओजस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Mighty, powerful, strong. 2 Splendid, bright. E. आजस्, and विनि aff.
ओडक: ओडक m. (-कः) A musical mode, which omits two of the notes of the scale, Ri and Pa.
ओड्र: ओड्र m. (-ड्रः) 1 The China rose, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 2 The name of a country, the northern part of Orissa. E. उड to embrace. रक affix, and उ is changed to ओ.
ओड्रपुष्प: ओड्रपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The China rose, the plant or its flower. E. ओड्र China rose, and पुष्प a flower.
ओण: ओण r. 1st cl. (ऋ) ओणृ (ओणति) To remove, to take away or abstract.
ओतु: ओतु m. (-तुः) A cat. E. अव to go, &c. and तु Uṇādi affix, the radical is changed to ओ.
ओदन: ओदन mn. (-नः-नं) Boiled rice. f. (-निका-नी) A plant, (Sida cordifolia, &c.) see वला. E. उन्द to be wet, ल्युट् Uṇādi affix, and न dropped.
ओद्म: ओद्म m. (-द्मः) Wetting, moistening. E. उन्द to be wet, मम् aff.
ओम्: ओम् ind. 1 The mystic name of the deity, prefacing all the prayers and most of the writings of the Hindus. E. अ a name of VIṢṆU, उ ŚIVA, and म of BRAHMA; it therefore implies the Indian triad, and expresses the three in one. 2 A particle of command or injunction, 3 Of assent, (verily, amen.) 4 Of auspiciousness. 5 Of removal, (away, hence,) and, 6 It is an inceptive particle. E. अव to go, to preserve, &c. मन् Uṇādi affix, the radical being converted into ओ.
ओल: ओल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wet, damp; also ओण. m. (-लः) An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.) E. वल or वल्ल to destroy, (complaints, especially hoemorrhoids.) अच् affix, व changed to ओ.
ओलड: ओलड r. 1st and 10th cls. (इ) ओलडि (ओलण्डति or ओलण्डयति.) To dart or throw up: some consider the initial vowel to be indicatory, and make the root लडि q. v.
ओष: ओष m. (-षः) Burning, combustion. E. उष to burn, घञ् aff.
ओषण: ओषण m. (-णः) Pungency, pungent taste or flavour. f. (-णी) A potherb, commonly Pūrya. E. उष to burn, and ल्यट् aff.
ओषधि: ओषधि f. (-धिः) An annual plant or herb, one that dies after becoming ripe. E. ओष heat, and धा to have, कि affix; or with ङीष्, ओषधी; or with इञ् affix, औषधि.
ओषधी: ओषधी f. (-धी) An annual plant or deciduous herb: see the preceding.
ओषधीपति: ओषधीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. ओषधी and पति lord: presiding over annual plants.
ओषधीश: ओषधीश m. (-शः) The moon. E. see the preceding; ईश meaning lord.
ओष्ठ: ओष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The lip, especially the upper, &c. du. m. (ओष्ठौ or ओष्ठाधरौ) The lips: see अधर. f. (-ष्ठी) A creeper, bearing a red flower, to which the lip is commonly compared, (Bryonia grandis.) E. उष to burn, थन् Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ङीष्: see विम्ब.
ओष्ठपल्लव: ओष्ठपल्लव n. (-वं) A lip or the lips. E. ओष्ठ and पल्लव a new shoot.
ओष्ठरोग: ओष्ठरोग m. (-गः) Any morbid affection of the lips. E. ओष्ठ and रोग disease.
ओष्ठोपमफला: ओष्ठोपमफला f. (-ला) The creeper, (Bryonia grandis:) see ओष्ठी. E. ओष्ठ a lip, उपम like, फल a flower, अच् and टाप् affixes; whose flower resembles a lip. औ
